description: Manages and provides access to the organizational structure and hierarchy within the system, detailing relationships between different units.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchy
endpoints.description: Retrieves the complete current organizational hierarchy, showing the relationships between different organizational units.
example_uses: Show me the entire organizational structure.
Can I see the full org chart?
Retrieve all organizational units and their hierarchy.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to view the complete, current organizational structure without filtering.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchyLegacy
endpoints.description: Retrieves the legacy version of the organizational hierarchy. This endpoint is for historical data or systems still relying on the older structure.
example_uses: Show me the legacy org structure.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when specifically requesting the older or legacy version of the organizational hierarchy.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationHierarchyById
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific organizational unit by ID with complete details including hierarchy information.
example_uses: Show me details for org unit ID 138
Display org unit details for ID 789
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific organizational unit details by ID.

endpoints.name: GetMetadataInfo
endpoints.description: Describes the OrganizationHierarchy entity structure including all field configurations. This endpoint provides schema information for the organizational hierarchy data.
example_uses: What fields are available for organizational hierarchy?
Tell me about the structure of the organization hierarchy data.
Get metadata for the organization hierarchy entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to understand the data model or available fields for the OrganizationHierarchy entity.
